name: fire-truck
description: A European fire engine (a pumper): a forward-control crew cab with a raked windscreen, light bar, grille, mirrors, steps, glazed doors and seats inside; an equipment body with roller-shutter lockers along both sides, low lockers by the rear wheels, a rear pump compartment, hose reels, a roof deck with railings, an access ladder and reflective stripes; underneath the frame, axles, pump, tank and exhaust on truck wheels, twin at the rear. The ladder is an extension ladder on a roof rack or a turntable aerial ladder with four outriggers; red, lime-yellow or white.

params.name: length
params.description: Overall length in metres (a two-axle pumper is about 7.5-9 m).

params.name: height
params.description: Roof height of the equipment body above the ground.

params.name: ladder
params.description: 0 = no ladder, 1 = an extension ladder on the roof rack, 2 = a turntable aerial ladder with outriggers (a quint).

params.name: colour
params.description: 0 = fire-engine red with white stripes, 1 = lime-yellow with red stripes, 2 = white with red stripes.

params.name: lockersPerSide
params.description: Roller-shutter lockers along each side of the body.

params.name: crewCab
params.description: A crew cab with a second row of doors (for 6-9 firefighters) instead of a single cab.
